## RE:volution Mod v2.4.0

### Added

- Added the server-authoritative Pet System with 18 technical Pet definitions, factual rank progression, persistent Pet state, and a functional inventory tab.
- Added 8 run-scoped normal Pet slots and 2 permanent premium Pet slots.
- Added Pet XP and uncapped level progression for active online Pets, including self-benefiting `PET_XP_MULTIPLIER` resolution.
- Added Pet Awakening, real-time cooldowns, deterministic active-slot compaction, and one-step Pet Rank Revert through `CTRL + right-click`.
- Added shared Effect Resolver integration for Pet damage/resource/XP effects, trade-offs, exact zero multipliers, and server-authoritative autoclick as CLICK damage.
- Added the official Fragments of Knowledge identity on the existing Prestige `runBranchCurrency` and data-driven Fragment rewards through Balance Core.
- Added a server-authoritative Run Exchange foundation without shipping unapproved exchange offers or rates.

### Fixed

- Bound Pet run state and normal-slot purchase pricing to the factual active Prestige run so a new run cannot reuse stale normal slots or purchase indices.
- Integrated Pet selective reset into the same guarded Prestige reset commit: lower ranks wipe while `ADVANCED+` progression and permanent premium entitlement are preserved.
- Kept normal-slot purchase indexing continuous through Pet Awakening and reset it only at the Prestige run boundary.

### Other

- Pet prices, effect values, XP curves, rank scaling, slot costs, cooldowns, premium slot costs, and Fragment rewards are data-driven through Balance Core and remain ZBT Draft values.
- `ANCIENT` Pet rank is reserved and is not part of v2.4.0 gameplay.
- Final Pet names, artwork, final balance, large UI polish, concrete Run Exchange offers, Forge gameplay, Artifacts, Mastery Quest, Generic Quest System, and Collection Meta Reset remain out of scope.
- Expanded regression coverage for Pet gameplay, persistence, network packets, Prestige reset behavior, Run Exchange foundation, and data-driven Fragment rewards.

### Download

Use the matching server and client gameplay artifacts published for this stable release.
